sources_read: .qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r16/rules/WebDev Rubrics QC.xlsx (Quality Checks row 5 = check 4; Internal Quality Checks row 5; Deterministic Checks row 31 check-runtime-contract-strings.py)
evidence: RUNTIME FACT LIST (each launch assumption of tests/test.sh against the public text). Path: instruction.md:5 'Put the app in /app and serve the workspace at /'; integration.md:3 'Put the finished app in /app.' Start command and cwd: integration.md:3 'I start it with node /app/server.js from a working directory that may be outside /app. Resolve files from their actual location.' (test.sh:68 requires /app/server.js; test.sh:97-111 launches node $APP_ENTRY from a non-/app cwd). Port and bind: integration.md:3 'Listen on port 3000 on 0.0.0.0 (PORT is set to 3000 at launch)' (test.sh:108 PORT=3000; probes and every judge prompt use localhost:3000). Health: integration.md:3 'answer GET /api/health promptly' (test.sh:48; app_context.md:25). Storage: integration.md:9 'Use SQLite for persistent records. The default database path is /app/app.db. If DB_PATH is set, open that absolute path instead, including when the app runs from a writable copy outside /app.' (test.sh:98-102,109 sets DB_PATH to /app/app.db or /tmp/submission/app.db). Runtime packages: integration.md:5 'The launch image supplies Node 22, Express and better-sqlite3 through NODE_PATH ... opening the finished app must not require an install or build step' (test.sh:106; both Dockerfiles pin express@5.1.0 and better-sqlite3@12.4.1). Restart: integration.md:7 and behaviour.md:9 'saved work and history must survive a complete server restart' (restart helper test.sh:127-184). Symlinks: integration.md:11 matches test.sh:72-83. Seed: instruction.md:3 and integration.md:7 name /assets/seed_data.json and say it holds no user snippets; the file has "snippets": [] and the Dockerfile copies it (line 15). Accounts: instruction.md:5 'without signing in'; overview.md:3 'without accounts'; policy.md:3 'without sign-in or private accounts'; app_context.md:10 'None'. Fixed clock: none is stated and none is needed; no criterion grades a date or a clock value (cw_save_reload_restart: 'how times or dates are displayed does not matter'); the only time rule is the five-second run budget, stated in behaviour.md:5. instruction.md:3 says 'six notes in /instructions' and six note files exist and are copied (Dockerfile:14). Network is public, so no offline constraint is expected. GRADED-VERSUS-ASKED: I mapped every criterion in the two gates (3), functional (43), polish (6) and visual (3) to a public sentence. All behavioural demands trace to behaviour.md, ui.md, security.md, overview.md or integration.md, e.g. cw_restore_request_repeat_safe -> behaviour.md:13 'Send saves and restores as ordinary HTTP requests from the page. If the same restore request is sent again after it was already committed ... it must not create another revision'; cw_interaction_starts_fresh_budget -> behaviour.md:5; cw_preview_isolation fetch leg -> security.md:3 'fetch requests to outside addresses or to this app's own routes must fail'; cw_caret_kept_in_view -> ui.md:5 Ctrl+Home/Ctrl+End and 'The caret must stay in view'; cw_undo_redo_availability, cw_focus_returns_to_code, cw_unsaved_marker, cw_narrow_width_usable, cw_controls_keyboard_and_focus -> ui.md:17; cw_custom_document_surface -> ui.md:3; cw_shared_saved_record -> behaviour.md:9 and integration.md:7. I found no criterion asserting an exact label, route, colour, schema or golden-only default. Weak app tried: an app that keeps the library only in browser storage or ignores DB_PATH - the brief explicitly forbids both, so its failure is attributable. Conforming alternative tried: an app that reads files relative to its own location, stores at DB_PATH, and uses any route names - nothing in test.sh or the criteria rejects it (functional prompt: 'Do not guess URL paths or API routes'). NOTES (not defects in this row): (1) test.sh:107 injects HOME (set to the /tmp/submission copy) and the brief names PORT, DB_PATH and NODE_PATH but not HOME, and it does not say the process runs as an unprivileged user (uid 65534) with a cleared environment. The frozen template integration.md names neither, test.sh is byte-identical to the template, and no graded behaviour depends on HOME; whether check-runtime-contract-strings.py accepts the unnamed HOME belongs to the deterministic review. (2) cw_html_preview requires a button 'whose inline handler changes visible text'; the brief asks for this only through 'A complete .html file replaces that document' and 'The browser may execute supported code in the preview' - an inference from ordinary HTML rather than an explicit sentence, and security.md does not list handler attributes among the refused forms, so I treat it as asked. (3) cw_console_levels_in_order uses console.warn/error/info; the brief says only 'Show console output in the order it was written' - a professional default. (4) cw_long_line_editing fails a line 'wrapped into several numbered lines'; ui.md:7 says 'keep a long unwrapped line horizontally reachable', which supports it. RUN EVIDENCE: all 22 hashes in raw-evidence-index.json match (16 scripted artifacts byte-exact; 6 hosted-run JSON files match after LF normalisation, as the index says). run_golden.sh launches the golden with 'cd /tmp && exec setsid env -i PATH=... NODE_PATH=... HOME=/app PORT=3000 DB_PATH=/app/app.db setpriv --reuid=65534 ... node /app/server.js' and results/runtime.json shows the app served and ran, so the stated contract is sufficient for the golden on these bytes under a test.sh-like launch (it used HOME=/app rather than the copy, and the agent image rather than the verifier image). The hosted configured-judge run is on an earlier candidate and is not a measurement of these bytes; no configured judge run exists for these bytes, hence PARTIAL. This row is a document-agreement check and does not itself require a judge run.
